question.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn><mo> </mo><mi>mL</mi></math> of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mo> </mo><mi>NaCl</mi></math> is required to coagulate <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>200</mn><mo> </mo><mi>mL</mi></math> of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>As</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></math> solution in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn></math> hours. The coagulating value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>NaCl</mi></math> is ___________.

solution.text:
Coagulating value =Millimoles of electrolyteVolume of sol in litre

20 ml of 0.5 M NaCl contains NaCl=20×0.5=10 milli moles

200 ml of As2S3 required NaCl for the coagulation =10 milli moles

∴ 1000 ml of As2S3 required NaCl for the coagulation =10×1000/200=50 milli moles.
